transcript: When you drink warm water in the morning, your body responds immediately, not on the surface, not where you can see it, but deep inside. Warm water enters an empty stomach and moves gently along the lining. There is no shock, no resistance, the stomach stays calm, relaxed, the warmth softens the muscles, blood flow increases just a little, enough to wake the tissues and prepare the body for digestion. Slowly, gentle movement begins, the stomach and intestines start to work together, guiding things forward without force, without pressure. As the water travels deeper, it hydrates what has been resting overnight. Waste softens, movement becomes easier, nothing is rushed. Later in the day, that hydration spreads through the body, organs fall back into rhythm, digestion stays balanced, warm water does not push the system, it does not demand, it supports the body quietly, from the inside out. If your body and mind are asking for healing, time to heal is waiting for you in the link on my profile.
